data.name: Celsius Strays
data.detailed_description:
You are the Chief of the Squealers.

It has been nine years since the coup to save your people failed, and you were banished to a far corner of the Slums. Survival is a luxury here, with robotic death squads, a deadly climate, and power-hungry Slumlords all eager to snuff out the defiant remnant of rats.

Manage your team, protect your colony, be a leader. And remember: in a world set against you, not all danger comes from outside.

This is an interactive, puzzle-lite Visual Novel where the choices you make, and the relationships you build, shape the future of the story.

Features

  • Over 200 unique, hand-drawn character portraits, with animated lipsyncing

  • Dozens of interactable locations that take you to the yet-unseen corners of Atlasia

  • Full-screen CGs

  • Determine what sort of leader you will be with meaningful choices that impact the core story and shape the future of the Squealers.

  • Send your crew out on missions to gather resources, scout out locations, and deepen their bonds with one another.

  • Voice acting for every character, with full performances during key story moment and cutscene

  • Fully original soundtrack

  • Unlockable extras, including concept art, game modifiers, and more

Developed with the publicly-accessible, free BROKVN engine.

data.short_description: "Banished. Hunted. Yet, we endure." Become the Chief of the Squealers and lead your people through a futuristic wasteland fraught with danger where every choice is about survival.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese, Czech, Polish, Romanian, Turkish
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7, 8.1, 10 or 11 (64 bits)
  • Processor: 1.5 GHz Dual Core
  • Memory: 3 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel(R) HD Graphics 5000, Nvidia or ATI card with at least 1GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Linux & Steam Deck compatible through Proton.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64 bits)
  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz Quad Core
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 650 2GB or AMD Radeon HD 7770 2GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Linux & Steam Deck compatible through Proton.
